parsed.explanation: Rated as a division under the parent national regime, which already carries documented traveller-facing exposures: passport sex-marker restrictions now in effect, refusals and possible lifetime fraud findings at entry, and documented abuse in immigration custody. The division adds its own layer. It has an enforced criminal ban on gender-expressive performance on public property, with a repeat-offence felony, upheld on appeal and left standing. Facilities are governed by birth sex, including a 2026 statute that mandates birth-sex prison placement and bars trans women from shelters. Gender markers on birth certificates are closed, and the 2019 indecent-exposure definition is unenforcement-tested. Care for inmates is barred. There is no statewide non-discrimination protection, religious-refusal laws are in place, and the record describes police inaction toward assaults on LGBTQ people. The 7.8/100k killing figure rests on 10 deaths and is an undercount floor, so I give it no weight. No organised sweeps are documented here. The universal birth-sex facility rule and the enforced presentation statute place this below the parent average, with no offsetting working remedy in the record.
